lines.text: A poor man who walks with integrity is better than a fool whose lips are perverse.
Wealth attracts many friends, but a poor man is deserted, and everyone is a friend of the gift giver.
A king's rage is like the roar of a bear, and a prudent wife is from the LORD.
Kindness to the poor is a loan to the king, and He will repay the lender.
Many plans are in a man's heart, but the purpose of the LORD will prevail.
